notes.title: First new DLC chapter The Lost Depths announced!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796408/63362e6a492c3f960ae13fca77c92d0c4ae454df.png[/img]

[h2]Explore the depths of the lost city of Atlantis and rebuild an ancient artefact.[/h2]

[b]Coming Soon[/b] to [b]Steam[/b] - Venture deeper into the mystery of [b]Infinite Inside[/b] with [b]The Lost Depths[/b], the first new DLC chapter that delves into the influence of the Plinth on ancient mythology. A new Plinth appears, sending you on a journey to rebuild a crucial artefact and deliver it to the lost civilisation of [b]Atlantis[/b].

[previewyoutube=dSSiITscZ_0;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]A Unique Adventure[/h3]

Discover a newly designed level inspired by [b]Atlantis[/b], featuring ethereal underwater environments, expanded game mechanics, and fresh puzzles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796408/c670a6520c152a185c2aca2ae1c23c500eb771ef.png[/img]
[h3]Introducing the Challenge Room[/h3]

Prove your skill to the Plinth in a timed challenge, solving a vital puzzle before the room closes in. Complete this trial to gain the Plinth’s trust in delivering the artefact.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796408/8e6f47ab2658e2c4acea2d4e8a243f0b160c4cc3.png[/img]

[h3]Replayable Challenges[/h3]

Once unlocked, revisit the [b]Challenge Room[/b] with other keys from the game, offering new ways to test yourself and master the puzzles. Compete for the fastest solve time and top the global leaderboard.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796408/1e466a18f854b39ce1904dcb7577bc37a4757cae.png[/img]

[h3]Wishlist Now![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2729540/The_Infinite_Inside

notes.title: Nominate Infinite Inside for VR Game of the Year at the Steam Awards 2024!
notes.content:
Nominations for the [b]Steam Awards 2024[/b] are now underway! For the duration of the [b]Autumn Sale[/b], we’re asking for your nomination for [b]VR Game of the Year[/b]. Thank you all for playing [b]Infinite Inside[/b], and all the support you’ve so generously shown to us so far.

If you feel like throwing some more support our way, your nomination would mean the world to us.

Thank you!
- [b]Maze Theory[/b]

notes.title: Infinite Inside Patch 1 - Visual Quality Update Released
notes.content:
[h1][/h1]

[i]Thank you for the fantastic feedback on the release of Infinite Inside. We are thrilled to announce the release of the first patch for Infinite Inside! [/i]

[b]Check out the details below![/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Enhanced Visuals: [/b]Higher resolution on PCVR.
[*] [b]Upgraded Lighting:[/b] Real-time shadows and improved lighting on PCVR.
[*] [b]New Save System: [/b]More frequent saving across all platforms.
[*] [b]Bug Fixes & Improvements:[/b] Various issues resolved across all platforms.
[/list]
We can't wait for you to dive in and experience the latest updates!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796408/cb6ab532812e3a629bed0e26b9c2e9ad266c3190.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Patch 1
notes.content: Added Mid Chapter Saves (the game saves collected puzzle pieces and creates checkpoints when you solve a puzzle/insert it into the plinth), Improved resolution and lighting/shadows as well as several bug fixes

notes.title: Infinite Inside out now on Steam!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796408/3a2ddfb7e0ddfc34464a215481e07d64ef11b40f.png[/img]

[b]Infinite Inside[/b] is [b]OUT NOW[/b] on [b]Steam VR[/b]! 

[h2]WATCH THE LAUNCH TRAILER[/h2]

[previewyoutube=EXXnVYJ6g7w;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]GET NOW[/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2729540/The_Infinite_Inside/

It's been a long journey for the team and we couldn't be more excited to finally be releasing the full experience to the world. If you're entering the impossible for the first time, here's everything you need to know about the game.

[h2]What is Infinite Inside?[/h2]

Explore an enchanting and mysterious world, collect shards, solve intricate puzzles, and assemble keys to unlock the mysteries of a secret society.

When the enigmatic ancient artifact known as the 'Plinth' mysteriously materialises in your home, it opens a portal to a tranquil, dream-like world, filled with impossible architecture and hidden secrets waiting to be discovered. Guided by the echoes of past explorers, you will collect shards, solve three-dimensional puzzles, and assemble keys to unlock the mysteries of a secret society committed to maintaining the balance of Order and Chaos. 

Can you solve the puzzles and reveal the truth about the society, the legacy of the Plinth, and ultimately, your own place in this mystical world?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796408/3f9187c5597e4282ab4a53f5fd88d5774babbff0.png[/img]

[h2]What To Expect[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796408/7d89816ef18bb635baa9d4c38324b137e0e5df24.png[/img]
Escape into five peaceful and soothing labyrinths filled with mysteries.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796408/01167233e817e1be3d506f39672ad2c50d4d943f.png[/img]
Engage with a deep and captivating story embedded in the world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796408/07d37871cda11b978b5798dfe544a4838f997707.png[/img]
Tackle mind-bending geometric puzzles at your own pace with intuitive controls.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796408/7086b2a1dea63821dccc5b5aad1cafd72d49731a.png[/img]
Immerse yourself in rich, captivating audio and music, deepening your connection with the world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796408/61d478b959ca0fa946b93e93c2a0d024fb8c5fdf.png[/img]

[h2]What Others Have Been Saying[/h2]

Reviews have begun to roll out for [b]Infinite Inside[/b] and the response has been fantastic! The game has been called “innovative”, “atmospheric”, and “gorgeous” by the leading XR news outlets. Check out the full reviews below:

9/10 - [url=https://www.thesixthaxis.com/2024/07/10/infinite-inside-review/]TheSixthAxis[/url]

9/10 - [url=https://www.godisageek.com/reviews/infinite-inside-review/]God is a Geek[/url]

4/5 - [url=https://www.uploadvr.com/infinite-inside-review/]UploadVR[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796408/81657a2ec36f110ad9afe17be7336ae8f61875bb.png[/img]

[h2]Listen to the Soundtrack[/h2]

Enjoy the enchanting and serene [b]Infinite Inside[/b] soundtrack by [b]Steven Coltart[/b] from start to finish on all major music streaming platforms.

[url=https://ditto.fm/infinite-inside-video-game-soundtrack style=button]LISTEN NOW[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796408/4e0d6d8cb86a2642880b355b0e85ce259a4e1c06.jpg[/img]

[h2]Win a Meta Quest 3[/h2]

To celebrate the launch of [b]Infinite Inside[/b], [b]Maze Theory[/b] are offering you the chance to win a [b]Meta Quest 3[/b]! 

Complete as many actions as possible to increase your chances of winning! Enter by [b]21st July[/b] and keep an eye on the [b]Infinite Inside[/b] socials to find out if you’ve won!

[url=https://gleam.io/EmkGA/win-a-meta-quest-3-with-infinite-inside-and-maze-theory style=button]ENTER NOW[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796408/6861d4b2d7720e3fa49aef6f8b97cc711d60db37.jpg[/img]

[h2]GET NOW[/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2729540/The_Infinite_Inside/
